stories.title: The retry storm
stories.one_liner: Found a retry design flaw and made the worker path idempotent.
stories.body: A PostgreSQL-backed queue was intermittently losing jobs. I traced worker logs, reproduced the contention locally, isolated retries, and added idempotency checks. Failed jobs fell by 40%, and I added queue-depth alerts plus a responder runbook.
